items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He was awfully ill and the train came and I had to grab Cliff.

ctx.x: up in the Bronx area somewhere. He was awfully ill and the train came and I had to grab Cliff. Cliff was out of commission for about a year.
He's well now and he's doing just fine.
